sourcePolicy: Official dated sources only. This is a verified-at snapshot, not live EU-portal connectivity. New calls and amendments require refresh. Application eligibility always depends on the exact official call package. Added media-specific official EC leads with explicit country, timing and topic gates; no new live API connection.

opportunities.title: NEWS - Media Literacy 2027: cross-border media literacy
opportunities.timingBasis: Indicative evaluation results July 2027; grant-agreement signature expected October 2027. The July-01 date is the start-of-month lower bound, NOT a confirmed award date.
opportunities.eligibilityRule: At least 3 independent legal organisations from 3 different Creative Europe participating countries; North Macedonia is listed as participating. Consortium, legal applicant, country and activity fit require exact call verification.
opportunities.format: Media literacy training, tools, public awareness, education, campaigns and cross-border knowledge exchange (normally up to 24 months).
opportunities.avoid: Not a generic public-relations budget or standalone conference/journal operating grant. Spring 2027 Ohrid event occurs before indicative grant award.

opportunities.title: Journalism Partnerships - Collaborations (2027)
opportunities.timingBasis: Evaluation results expected August 2027; grant agreement expected November 2027; date uses beginning of indicated month as a conservative bound, not a guaranteed award date.
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Cross-border collaborative news-media projects; consortium and eligible legal/media organisations must meet the full call document, including editorial-independence annex.
opportunities.format: Transnational journalism-business resilience, newsrooms, reporting methods and media skills.
opportunities.avoid: Academic journal is not automatically a news media outlet; the spring 2027 conference predates grant award.

opportunities.title: Information measures for EU Cohesion policy 2026
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Applicants generally must be legal entities established in EU Member States; international organisations are a limited exception. This is NOT directly eligible for a North Macedonia-based WPA applicant.
opportunities.format: Independent media and public communication about the EU Cohesion policy.
opportunities.avoid: North Macedonia-based WPA is not eligible as the direct ordinary applicant; do not confuse expected EUR 200k grant with proposed EUR 300k budget.

opportunities.title: Cooperation Partnerships — 2027 programme route
opportunities.country: North Macedonia is an Erasmus+ associated country; country eligibility must be checked for the exact 2027 action.
opportunities.eligibilityRule: 2026 guide precedent: applicant/coordinator legally established at least 2 years; minimum 3 independent organisations from 3 participating countries. Verify the 2027 guide before using.
opportunities.format: transnational cooperation / capacity project; a conference can be an eligible activity, not the entire application
opportunities.avoid: Standalone event subsidy; ordinary journal operating expenses. Spring 2027 conference funding is NOT established by the 2027 programme work plan.
opportunities.note: 2027 annual work programme published 15 Oct 2026. Exact 2027 deadline, start window, applicant and funding rules UNVERIFIED; 2026 guidance must not be presented as a confirmed 2027 call.

opportunities.title: Union values: financial-support intermediaries
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Call for intermediaries providing financial support to third parties, not direct support for a stand-alone conference or journal.
opportunities.avoid: Do not treat a publishing, training or conference platform as an eligible intermediary unless the full call requirements are met.

opportunities.title: Networks of Towns — indicative planning 2027
opportunities.eligibilityRule: A genuine town-network action; not generic conference sponsorship. Exact topic documents not yet published as of this index.
opportunities.avoid: Indicative dates are not confirmed call conditions. Selection information expected September 2027; not an appropriate spring 2027 funding route.

opportunities.title: Equality and non-discrimination — indicative planning 2027
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Only genuine equality and anti-discrimination actions; exact 2027 call eligibility unverified.
opportunities.avoid: Do not rebrand a diplomacy conference or journal to fit the equality call.

opportunities.title: Public-sector expert mission / workshop / study visit
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Public administrations/public bodies in eligible countries can request discrete technical assistance on a rolling basis. No direct support to civil society organisations, private citizens or companies.
opportunities.avoid: Not a general grant or funding for the whole conference / journal / private products.

opportunities.title: Regional cooperation and institutional capacity — opportunity watch
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Check a real specific EU Delegation, IPA or Western Balkans call. No open call is represented by this programme-family record.
opportunities.avoid: No verified deadline, funding rate or applicant eligibility for a specific topic.

opportunities.title: Мерка 1: инвестиции во земјоделски стопанства · програмска патека
opportunities.callId: КОНКРЕТЕН ЈАВЕН ПОВИК НЕ Е ПОТВРДЕН ЗА ОВАА СЕСИЈА
opportunities.country: Република Северна Македонија; точниот јавен повик ги определува корисниците
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Проверете конкретен активен јавен повик и корисничко упатство за Мерка 1. Правниот/регистрацискиот статус, видот на инвестицијата, доказите и кофинансирањето се утврдуваат само таму.
opportunities.avoid: Програмска патека НЕ Е отворен повик; историскиот повик 01/2025 завршил во 2025. Не ветувај грант/процент без тековно упатство.

opportunities.title: Домашни јавни повици за земјоделство · провери ја мерката
opportunities.callId: КОНКРЕТЕН ТЕКОВЕН ПОВИК НЕ Е ПРОВЕРЕН
opportunities.eligibilityRule: Ова е национална програма, НЕ е истиот фонд како EU IPARD III. Применливоста зависи од конкретниот јавен повик, мерка и документација.
opportunities.avoid: Не претставувај список со повици како потврда дека некој е сè уште отворен.
